html:
An army officer who seized power in Mauritania in December 1984 and ruled until he was overthrown in August 2005 while abroad.

His years saw the 1989 crisis with Senegal, the expulsion of black Mauritanians and the killing of black soldiers in 1990 and 1991. He brought in a multiparty constitution in 1991 and won elections that opponents called unfair. He sided with Iraq in 1990, then turned to the West and in 1999 made Mauritania one of the few Arab League states to recognise Israel. Officers removed him in 2005 while he attended a funeral in Saudi Arabia. See also Moktar Ould Daddah.
sum: An army officer who seized power in Mauritania in December 1984 and ruled until he was overthrown in August 2005 while abroad.
